description: coral-agents/buyer-agent/src/goal.ts exports BUYER_GOAL, BUYER_REQUEST, TARGET_AGENT, BUYER_MAX_SOL, QUOTE_WAIT_MS, DELIVERY_WAIT_MS, CYCLE_INTERVAL_MS but is never imported by any other file in the buyer-agent package — src/index.ts reads its own process.env.BUYER_SERVICE/BUYER_ARG/CYCLE_INTERVAL_MS directly instead of this module's constants. This is pre-existing dead code, untouched by any of the 8 round-1 fixes, and is exactly the class of issue round-1 FIND-006 flagged elsewhere in the same repo (undocumented/unused code) — this instance was missed and remains undocumented as dead.

evidence.snippet:
